target: Mean measured segment travel time in seconds, grouped by completion time into the next UTC bin
travel_time_definition: arrived_at minus departed_at; departure at upstream stop to arrival at downstream stop; excludes upstream dwell
node_definition: Directed (route_id, from_stop_id, to_stop_id) segment; route_id obtained from GTFS trip_id
aggregation: Mean of completed traversals in each bin; bins are [start, end)
missing_inputs: Causal forward fill per segment; training median before first measurement; observed=0 for missing bins
missing_targets: Masked out of loss and metrics; never filled for supervision
scaling: Per-node mean and population standard deviation of observed TRAIN bin means only; standard deviation below 1e-6 becomes 1
time_features: UTC bin-start hour including minutes divided by 24; weekday Monday=0 divided by 7; sin/cos with 2*pi
availability: A bin is available only after its end; predictions require an as_of timestamp aligned to a bin boundary
postprocessing: Inverse scale, then clip negative travel-time estimates to zero
eta_scope: Segment traversal duration; not waiting time, whole-journey ETA, or remaining time for a bus already partway through a segment
